facts.fact: StackAdapt states that rich media banners can be used as an upper-funnel strategy to capture attention for awareness and gather insights about an audience.
facts.quote: Rich media banners can be used as an upper funnel strategy to capture attention for awareness and provide insights to learn more about your audience.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that lead ads let a target audience complete a form with just a few clicks, making it easy to book a virtual appointment.
facts.quote: These allow your target audience to complete a form with just a few clicks, making it easy to book a virtual appointment with you.
